fact_check.claim: 'originally called ton coin and now they call it gram' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified: the TON Foundation renamed Toncoin to Gram on June 15, 2026 (ticker TON to GRAM at 20:00 UTC) after a community vote that passed with 81.22% support; only the token name, ticker and icon changed, the blockchain stays The Open Network, balances converted 1:1 with no claim or bridge. Gram was the 2018 name of Telegram's original token. Copy writes 'Gram ($GRAM, the old $TON)' so both cashtags ride. Image reference toncoin-ton.png is the TON network diamond (the chain mark, unchanged); the prompt describes it as the network logo, never as the new token icon.

fact_check.claim: 'it's $1.26 right now... I just saw like $1.19... all time high $7.88' (transcript, TON chart)
fact_check.verdict: updated to drafting-day values: TON/GRAM trades at about $1.19 on October 27, 2026 (MetaMask 04:23 UTC $1.19, Kraken $1.19, Coinbase $1.21), market cap about $3.39B, down about 47% year over year; the record high is $8.25 (MetaMask / CoinMarketCap basis), so copy says 'about $1.19' and 'more than 85% below its $8.25 all-time high' (1.19 / 8.25 = 14.4%). Mike's $7.88 was his exchange's chart; the aggregate ATH is used.

fact_check.claim: 'over a billion monthly users on telegram... every crypto mini app in telegram has to run on ton... wallet is rolled out to the user base' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified: Pavel Durov announced in March 2025 that Telegram passed 1 billion monthly active users; the TON Foundation made TON the exclusive blockchain for Telegram Mini Apps (non-TON apps had until February 21, 2025 to migrate); the self-custodial TON Wallet went live for US users in July 2025 alongside the in-app wallet. Copy: 'over a billion monthly users', 'every mini app inside Telegram has to run on TON', 'the wallet is built into the app'.
fact_check.source: techcrunch.com/2025/03/19/telegram-founder-pavel-durov-says-app-now-has-1b-users...; thedefiant.io (Telegram partners exclusively with TON for mini apps); blockeden.xyz/blog/2026/01/26/ton-telegram-web3-onramp-mini-apps-500-million-users/

fact_check.claim: 'Ton is now on Pumpphone, so the Pumpphone app' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: UNVERIFIED and dropped: no report of TON / Gram on Pump.fun, Pump Bridge (test chains Robinhood, BNB Chain, Base, Arc, Ink; Solana app) or Phantom (TON not in its network list). Likely a mishear of an app name; the Gram tweet carries no listing claim. Operator may ask Mike what app he meant.

fact_check.claim: 'Tom Lee says... 99% of finance still runs on old rails and that's exactly why banks are underestimating how fast crypto could take over; banks without a crypto plan could get left behind' (transcript, Mike reading a post)
fact_check.verdict: verified as reported: Cointelegraph's X post (status 2114424458265935999, October 2026) carries that exact wording, repeated by KuCoin news. No primary interview transcript located, so the tweet attributes it as 'Tom Lee says' and quotes only the reported line.

fact_check.claim: 'In five years... digital intelligence will exceed the sum of all human intelligence... at least a hundred million humanoid robots but maybe a billion... economy probably twice its current size in five to seven years' (transcript, Mike playing a clip)
fact_check.verdict: verified: Elon Musk's remarks (Forbes Innovator 250 event, May 19, 2026, recirculated on X in October 2026): 'In 5 years, digital intelligence will exceed the sum of all human intelligence', 100 million to possibly 1 billion humanoid robots within five years, the economy could double in 5 to 7 years. Copy attributes to Musk and uses those three figures.

fact_check.claim: 'Jensen Wong of NVIDIA said... radiology, completely wiped out' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: NOT verified, the opposite is on record: Huang has repeatedly said more radiologists are being hired because of AI (about 20% more) and called the early 'radiology will be automated' forecast harmful. The attribution is dropped; the AI tweet rests on Musk's quote and Mike's own first-hand software-engineering read.

fact_check.claim: 'nobody's writing code anymore, it's just AI writing the code... now they have code review agents' (transcript, Mike's first-hand read as a software engineer)
fact_check.verdict: Mike's own professional observation, written in first person ('I am a code monkey, I am in the know') and not asserted as an industry statistic.

fact_check.claim: 'pump fun... it's like two billion right now... conservatively eight billion or ten billion top of the bull run' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified and current: PUMP about $0.0042 with a circulating market cap of about $1.93B on October 27, 2026 (OKX; MetaMask $1.97B on October 24), ATH about $0.0089. October product beats verified: perpetual futures via Hyperliquid (October 17), pre-IPO token pairs including OpenAI (October 19), Pump Bridge as the default cross-chain route (October 21-22), daily revenue-funded burns logged on pump.fun's token page. The $8B to $10B top is Mike's own call, written as his number. 'Higher lows' is Mike's chart read, written as 'on my chart'.

fact_check.claim: 'we lost the 50-day moving average I guess four days ago... good final time to buy that dip... a market wide crash would be Bitcoin below the 50-week moving average' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified and current: Bitcoin closed a daily candle below its 50-day moving average on Friday October 23, 2026, the first close below it since August; on October 27 BTC trades about $79,800 (Coinbase, CoinGecko) against a 50-day average near $81,700, still below it. The 50-week SMA is about $76,100 to $76,540 (Galaxy Research uses $76,540). Copy: 'closed below the 50-day for the first time since August'; the 50-week level is not quoted in any copy.

fact_check.claim: 'stonk is another launchpad and it does the whole meme pairing with the tokenized assets' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified: StonkFun is a Solana launchpad whose tokens launch against tokenized equities and ETFs (Backed xStocks such as SPYx and NVDAx, PreStocks pre-IPO tokens, tokenized gold) instead of SOL; $STONK went live July 23, 2026 in a STONK/SPYx pool and became Raydium LaunchLab's first custom-quote partner on September 6, 2026. Price and market cap data for October 2026 conflict across trackers ($207M to $271M), so no number is used; Stonk appears only in a quiz on the pairing mechanic.
